_help: Sponsor slots. null = unsold (shows the 'Your company here' link to /sponsor.html). To sell a slot, replace null with {"name": "Acme", "url": "https://acme.com/?utm_source=openpajobs", "logo": "/logos/sponsors/acme.png", "tagline": "optional one line", "start": "YYYY-MM-DD", "end": null}, then run node scripts/build.mjs and commit. end = last day (UTC) or null for open-ended. Page keys: become-a-public-adjuster, remote (remote.html + /jobs/remote/), florida (locations/fl.html + /jobs/florida/), texas (locations/tx.html + /jobs/texas/).
